name: What types of outdoor lighting systems does AKN Design Group install?

mainEntity.name: What types of outdoor lighting systems does AKN Design Group install?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in designing and installing comprehensive, high-end outdoor lighting systems tailored to enhance functionality, beauty, and value for your home. Our projects often include landscape lighting to highlight architectural features and plantings, pathway lighting for safety and aesthetics, and task lighting for outdoor kitchens or seating areas. We integrate these elements into a cohesive design as part of a larger outdoor living space transformation, ensuring every component contributes to the overall vision for your backyard.
acceptedAnswer.description: We install comprehensive, high-end outdoor lighting systems, including landscape, pathway, and task lighting, as part of larger outdoor living space transformations.
